data.title: Eyal Zamir: Return to Iran war may postpone Israel election as Pentagon readies plans | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Three US aircraft carriers will soon be in the Middle East, the New York Times said, adding that the Pentagon had developed plan for a three-day campaign against Iran.
